title: Kraut Space Magic: the H&K G11
summary: Forgotten Weapons examines the Heckler & Koch G11, a West German experimental rifle built around a caseless cartridge. The video covers the G11K2 and its unusual technology before its cancellation for political and economic reasons.
why: Cited as an example of overly ambitious engineering, such as brittle caseless ammunition and heat-ejection problems.

quote.text: the H&K G11 also had ambitious objectives and was shock-full of clever ideas
